body:
In the margin I wrote that the orchard hands smelled of sweet spray and asked for water before service. Their youngest began shaking before the deputy closed the lane.

We tried to finish the ordinary work around it. The notice changed faster than the deliveries, and no one came to collect what was left.

The amount mattered to the office more than the people waiting outside. We stayed until dark because the last line still said to wait.
title: Prayer list, Tuesday margin
gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.
